title: info for a value obtained from a process
description: Provenance of a property that is a property of a fabrication run rather than of a measurement, e.g. a growth rate read off the deposition record. The process analogue of core/reference/exabyte.

stepFlowchartId.description: flowchartId of the step the value came from, the analogue of unitId

sampleId.description: Identity of the sample the process produced
